Do not recommend127 or255 as safe solely from byte width, or32 solely from the assignment interval.

Do not equate histogram-weighted sums with actual CityUpdate default trade without a packed-sentinel-tail proof, or promote the conditional raw food/production/trade contributions to final gameplay totals.
conclusion: Retain the supported cap of 31. A cap of 127 needs coherent saturation before narrowing, bounded assignment and lock operations, explicit surplus/default processing, histogram/caller and cost-table policies, downstream intervals, and complete contracts for UI, persistence and peers. The census of readers and writers is incomplete. Exhaustive raw-form searches and a candidate pass over all mapped owners do not establish semantic completeness.
